title: Thai Meat Pie
description: A twist on traditional Thai cuisine with a savory meat pie. Flaky pastry crust filled with zesty Thai-inspired meat filling.
instructions: Roll out pie crust to fit 9-inch pie dish.
In a large pan, cook Australian Grass-Feed Beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking into small pieces.
Add Onion and Bell Pepper to the pan, cooking until vegetables are tender.
Stir in Zesty Thai Red Curry Paste, cooking for 1-2 minutes.
Add Fish Sauce, Soy Sauce, and Brown Sugar to the pan, stirring to combine.
Pour in Coconut Milk and bring mixture to a simmer.
Stir in Thai Basil and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Transfer meat mixture to the pie crust.
Roll out remaining pie crust to fit top of pie.
Place top crust on pie and crimp edges to seal.
Cut slits in top crust to allow steam to escape.
Bake pie for 25-30 minutes, or until crust is golden brown and filling is hot and bubbly.
Let pie rest for 10-15 minutes before serving.
